name: model-axis-haiku-vs-gemini
title: Model axis: Hermes with prompt v2 on Claude Haiku 5.5 (A) and Gemini 3.8 Flash (B), 10 held-out tasks x 10
description: The model-axis run set out before it started (docs/experiment.md, Model axis; plan 517443e). The same Hermes config twice, differing only in the model. Haiku passes 79% against Gemini's 75%: -4 points (95% interval -20 to +16), sign-flip p = 0.81 over 10 tasks, no detectable difference. The tasks split: Gemini wins spending-review 10 of 10 against 3, by calling a tool for every sum, and falls on the conversation tasks, where it ran out of its 24 steps in 18 trials. It made twice the tool calls and cost about 4 times as much per trial.
experiment_name: Model axis: Claude Haiku 5.5 vs Gemini 3.8 Flash, Hermes, prompt v2, 10 held-out x 10
